description_en: Switches the timed scheduling toggle of a data validation task to control whether the task is periodically executed based on a Cron rule
description_zh: 切换数据校验任务的定时调度开关，控制其是否按 Cron 规则周期执行
kebab_example: aliyun lhm exec-data-check-toggle --params lastBatchId=20001 isScheduled=0 id=10001 --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecDataCheckToggle

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable scheduling. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
fields.help_zh: 是否启用调度：0-关闭 1-开启
fields.name: is_scheduled

parameters.help_en: The task scheduling parameter list. Each item must contain id, lastBatchId, and isScheduled
parameters.help_zh: 任务调度参数列表（每项需包含id、lastBatchId、isScheduled）
parameters.name: params

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, use errCode and errMessage to identify the cause
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
